newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom price spread fair - trader.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom price spread fair - trader.

text.p: Traders said the price spread set for shares in newly-floated Deutsche Telekom AG earlier on Monday was wide but reflected the price at which shares had been trading in the grey market before the issue.
The Deutsche Boerse stock exchange earlier marked Telekom shares, which were issued earlier at 28.50 marks, with a "bid" price of 31 marks and an "ask" price of 34 marks.
"That's pretty close to the truth," said one trader, noting that grey, or unofficial trade in the stock had earlier centred around a range of 32.50 to 33 marks.
Another trader agreed that the bid-ask spread focused on a level fairly close to what the market had been looking for.
The first official quotations of the trading price of the shares are due around 1130 GMT.
